qaris.name: Sheikh Mahmoud Khalil Al-Hussary
qaris.title: Imam & Master Qari
qaris.tagline: Renowned for his precise Tajweed and melodious recitation
qaris.bio:
Sheikh Mahmoud Khalil Al-Hussary is one of the most respected Quranic reciters in the New York Muslim community. Born in Egypt, he memorized the Holy Quran at a young age under the tutelage of senior scholars at Al-Azhar. He immigrated to the United States in 1998 and has since served as Imam at Masjid At-Taqwa in Brooklyn.

Over the past two decades, Sheikh Al-Hussary has trained hundreds of students in the art of Quran recitation, many of whom have gone on to lead congregational prayers across the country. He is known for his patient teaching style and his meticulous attention to the rules of Tajweed.

He hosts weekly Quran recitation circles every Saturday morning open to students of all levels. His recitation of Surah Al-Baqarah has been widely shared online and has been praised by scholars worldwide for its accuracy and beauty.

institutions: Al-Azhar University, Cairo — Faculty of Islamic Studies
degrees: B.A. in Quran and Islamic Sciences — Al-Azhar University (1993)
Diploma in Tajweed — Ma'had Al-Qira'at Al-Qur'aniyya (1994)
education.additional: Sheikh Al-Hussary holds full Ijazah in 10 Qira'at with a connected chain (Sanad) to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ through an unbroken chain of transmitters spanning over 1,400 years.

qaris.name: Sheikh Ismail Marzouq
qaris.title: Hafiz & Tajweed Instructor
qaris.tagline: Bridging classical Quranic education with the American Muslim experience
qaris.bio:
Sheikh Ismail Marzouq was born in Alexandria, Egypt, into a family deeply rooted in Quranic sciences. He completed his memorization of the Quran by age twelve and pursued formal Tajweed studies at the prestigious Ma'had Al-Qira'at in Alexandria before emigrating to the United States in 2003.

Based in Astoria, Queens — one of New York's most diverse Muslim neighborhoods — Sheikh Marzouq founded the Queens Quran Institute in 2009, which now serves over 300 students annually. The institute offers classes for children, adults, and even seniors, with a special program for new Muslims learning to read Arabic.

Sheikh Marzouq is particularly known for his work with youth, having helped dozens of young men and women complete their Hifz (memorization) in the New York area. He regularly judges at regional and national Quran competitions and is a sought-after speaker at Islamic conferences.

institutions: Islamic University of Madinah — Faculty of Quran
degrees: B.A. in Quran Studies — Islamic University of Madinah (2001)
Ijazah in 7 Qira'at — Ma'had Al-Qira'at Alexandria (2002)
education.additional: Sheikh Marzouq is the co-author of 'Tajweed Made Easy,' an English-language workbook used in Islamic schools across the United States and Canada.

qaris.name: Sheikh Abdul-Rahman Al-Sudais Jr.
qaris.title: Qari & Community Educator
qaris.tagline: Inspired by the Grand Mosque, serving the community of the Bronx
qaris.bio:
Sheikh Abdul-Rahman Al-Sudais Jr. carries on a proud legacy of Quranic excellence, having studied directly under senior scholars at the Masjid Al-Haram complex in Makkah before relocating to New York City. He has been serving as a Quran teacher at Masjid Al-Ikhlas in the South Bronx since 2010.

With a background in Islamic pedagogy, Sheikh Abdul-Rahman has developed innovative curricula that blend traditional Tajweed instruction with modern educational techniques. His classes use interactive exercises, recording technology, and peer review methods to accelerate student progress.

He is actively involved in interfaith dialogue initiatives in the Bronx and regularly collaborates with community organizations to provide Islamic educational resources to underserved Muslim communities. He also runs a free weekend Hifz program for children aged 6–16.

institutions: Masjid Al-Haram Quran Schools, Makkah Al-Mukarramah
degrees: B.A. in Sharia and Islamic Studies — Umm Al-Qura University (2007)
Diploma in Quran Pedagogy — Masjid Al-Haram Institute (2008)
education.additional: Sheikh Abdul-Rahman has completed Ijazah verification audits with scholars in Saudi Arabia and Egypt, maintaining a documented sanad connecting to Imam Hafs ibn Sulayman himself through a chain of 34 transmitters.

qaris.name: Ustadha Fatima Al-Zahraa
qaris.title: Hafiza & Women's Quran Teacher
qaris.tagline: Pioneering Quranic education for Muslim women in New York City
qaris.bio:
Ustadha Fatima Al-Zahraa is a leading figure in women's Quranic education in New York City. A Hafiza since the age of sixteen, she pursued advanced studies in Tajweed and Qiraat in Morocco and Egypt before settling in Manhattan, where she established the first dedicated women's Hifz circle in lower Manhattan in 2012.

Her program, 'Noor Al-Quran Sisters Circle,' has helped over 150 women complete partial or full memorization of the Quran. The circle meets three times weekly and includes students ranging from university students to grandmothers, all united by their love of the Quran.

Ustadha Fatima is a passionate advocate for women's access to classical Islamic education and frequently speaks at national Islamic conferences on the topic. She has also contributed to the development of female Quranic scholarship networks across the United States.

institutions: Al-Azhar Institute for Women's Studies, Cairo
degrees: Ijazah in Quran and Qiraat — Dar Al-Hadith Al-Hassaniyya (2008)
Diploma in Tajweed — Al-Azhar Institute for Women (2009)
education.additional: Ustadha Fatima is one of fewer than fifty women in North America holding authenticated Ijazah in two separate Qira'at with verified sanad chains.

qaris.name: Sheikh Khalid Abdullah Hussain
qaris.title: Imam & Quranic Scholar
qaris.tagline: Serving Staten Island's Muslim community with knowledge and humility
qaris.bio:
Sheikh Khalid Abdullah Hussain has been the resident Imam at Masjid Darul Quran on Staten Island since 2005. A Pakistani-American scholar trained in both Pakistan and the Arab world, he represents a unique synthesis of South Asian and Arab Quranic traditions.

Sheikh Khalid completed his memorization of the Quran at Jamia Darul Uloom Karachi before traveling to Egypt for advanced study in Tajweed and the sciences of the Quran. He is deeply committed to making Quranic education accessible to the growing Muslim population of Staten Island.

Beyond his teaching duties, Sheikh Khalid serves as a chaplain for Muslim inmates at Rikers Island and collaborates with local schools to provide Islamic education programs for Muslim youth. He is known for his eloquent Friday sermons that blend Quranic wisdom with practical guidance for Muslims living in the West.

institutions: Masjid Darul Quran, Staten Island (head imam)
degrees: Alimiyyah Degree — Jamia Darul Uloom Karachi (1997)
education.additional: Sheikh Khalid holds the rare distinction of having Ijazah in both the Arab (Egyptian) and South Asian (Deoband) traditions of Hafs 'an 'Asim, allowing him to teach students from both backgrounds with authentic authority.

qaris.name: Sheikh Omar Abdel-Hafiz
qaris.title: Hafiz & Youth Mentor
qaris.tagline: Inspiring the next generation of Huffaz on Long Island
qaris.bio:
Sheikh Omar Abdel-Hafiz is a second-generation Egyptian-American who completed his Hifz at age fourteen under his father's guidance and went on to earn formal Ijazah in Egypt and Saudi Arabia. He returned to Long Island — where he grew up — determined to build the kind of Quranic education infrastructure he wished had existed for him as a child.

In 2015, he co-founded the Long Island Quran Academy, which now operates out of three locations across Nassau County. The academy runs a full-time Hifz school as well as part-time evening and weekend programs. Over 40 students have completed their full Hifz through the academy since its founding.

Sheikh Omar is a dynamic speaker and is especially gifted at connecting with young Muslims who feel disconnected from Islamic tradition. He runs an annual 'Quran Summer Camp' that attracts students from across the tri-state area.

institutions: Studied under his father Sheikh Abdel-Hafiz Sr. (NY)
degrees: Ijazah in Hifz — Ma'had Al-Qira'at Cairo (2010)
Ijazah with Sanad — King Fahad Quran Complex (2012)
B.S. in Computer Science — Stony Brook University (2013)
education.additional: Sheikh Omar uniquely combines his background in technology with Islamic education, developing custom software tools for Hifz tracking used by over 20 Islamic schools nationwide.
